name: Message as Literal
hint: The finder detects a message name used as ordinary text while the corresponding message is expected to coordinate scripts. Text in a say, comparison, list, or similar block does not send a message, so receiver scripts may never run and the text can be misleading.
instruction: Use a broadcast or broadcast-and-wait block when the intention is to notify other scripts; keep a message name as text only when displaying or comparing that text is deliberate.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
say [myMsg]
when I receive \[myMsg v\]
move (10) steps

examples.label: Possible solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
broadcast (myMsg v)
say [Hello]
when I receive \[myMsg v\]
move (10) steps
